origin.details: Further arguments are passed to toJSON.
origin.value: Nothing. The file holds the JSON.
origin.example:
tmp <- tempfile()
write_json(list(a = 1L), tmp)
cat(paste(readLines(tmp), collapse = "\n"), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Writes toJSON text plus a newline.
translation.value: Nothing. The file holds the JSON.
translation.example:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from jsonlite import write_json
path = Path(tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".json")[1])
write_json({"a": 1}, path)
print(path.read_text().rstrip("\n"))
